parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The sort direction. Valid values:

- **desc**: Descending (default).
- **asc**: Ascending.

parameters.name: EntityName
parameters.description: The name of the entity to be disposed.

parameters.name: EntityType
parameters.description:
The type of the entity to be disposed. Valid values:

- **ip**: IP address entity.
- **file**: File entity.
- **process**: Process entity.

parameters.name: EntityUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the entity.

parameters.name: EventUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the event.

parameters.name: OrderField
parameters.description:
The field used to sort the results.

> You can obtain the sort field from the response of this operation.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page for paging queries. Default value: 20. If the PageSize parameter is left empty, 10 entries are returned by default.
> Do not leave PageSize empty.

parameters.name: ParamContent
parameters.description: The fuzzy match content. This parameter queries the entity, disposal scene, and disposal parameter fields.

parameters.name: ProcessActionEnd
parameters.description: The end time of the query range for the disposal time. Format: 13-digit timestamp.

parameters.name: ProcessActionStart
parameters.description: The start time of the query range for the disposal time. Format: 13-digit timestamp.

parameters.name: ProcessRemoveEnd
parameters.description: The end time of the query range for the unblocking time. Format: 13-digit timestamp.

parameters.name: ProcessRemoveStart
parameters.description: The start time of the query range for the unblocking time. Format: 13-digit timestamp.

parameters.name: ProcessStrategyUuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the disposal strategy.
>You can call the [ListDisposeStrategy](~~2584440~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: ReqUuid
parameters.description: The trigger ID of the playbook.

parameters.name: SceneCode
parameters.description:
The scene code of the disposal task.
>You can call the [DescribeEnumItems](~~DescribeEnumItems~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account ID for the disposal.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The trigger source of the disposal task, in array string format. Valid values:

- **system**: Triggered by manual event disposal.
- **custom**: Triggered by an automatic response rule based on an event.
- **custom_alert**: Triggered by an automatic response rule based on an alert.
- **soar-manual**: Triggered by manually invoking a SOAR playbook.
- **soar-mdr**: Triggered by the Managed Security Service.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description:
The unique identifier of the disposal task.

> This parameter is used to query a specific task. You can obtain the value from the response of this operation.

parameters.name: TaskStatus
parameters.description:
The status list of the disposal task, in data string format. Valid values:

- **11**: Disposing.
- **21**: Blocking.
- **22**: Isolating.
- **23**: Ended.
- **24**: Whitelisted.
- **20**: Succeeded.
- **90**: Failed.
- **91**: Unblocking failed.
- **92**: Unisolation failed.

parameters.name: TriggerSource
parameters.description:
The trigger source of the disposal task. Valid values:

- **system**: Triggered by manual event disposal.
- **custom**: Triggered by an automatic response rule based on an event.
- **custom_alert**: Triggered by an automatic response rule based on an alert.
- **soar-manual**: Triggered by manually invoking a SOAR playbook.
- **soar-mdr**: Triggered by the Managed Security Service.

parameters.name: YunCode
parameters.description:
The cloud product associated with the disposal task, in data string format. Valid values:

- **WAF**: Web Application Firewall.
- **CFW**: Cloud Firewall.
- **Aegis**: Security Center.
